title: Protocols for isolation and characterization of mouse placental hemogenic endothelial cells
protocol: Remove the yolk sac, embryo proper, and umbilical cord from a pregnant mouse.
Choose EGFP placentas by fluorescence microscopy.
Separate the placenta from the embryo proper and yolk sac.
Insert two pairs of forceps between the fetal and maternal sides to remove attached decidua.
Place placentas in DPBS in a 60 mm dish on ice.
Wash placentas twice in DPBS on ice.
Rinse placentas several times with DPBS until no obvious blood clots are observed.
Transfer placenta into 1.5 mL tubes containing pre-warmed digestion medium with 1 mg/mL Collagenase Type I-A and 0.04% DNase I.
Cut the placenta into fragments using ophthalmic scissors.
Dissect placental fragments using 20G and 25G needles.
Incubate placentas at 37°C for 30 minutes in a shaking incubator with 100 revolutions per minute.
Centrifuge tubes at 310 g for 5 minutes at 4°C and discard the supernatant.
Wash placentas in DPBS, then centrifuge them again.
Add 500 μL Accutase to the washed placentas and incubate at 37°C with shaking at 100 revolutions per minute for 6-8 minutes.
Add 500 μL of 2% FBS/DMEM, then centrifuge tubes at 310 g for 5 minutes at 4°C and discard the supernatant.
Treat tissues with RBC lysis buffer (1 mL) at room temperature for 5-10 minutes.
Centrifuge treated tissues in 1 mL of 2% FBS/DMEM, then wash them again.
Filter cells through single-use cell strainers to create a single-cell suspension.
Wash the strainer with 300 μL of 2% FBS/DMEM into original tubes.
Centrifuge tubes at 310 g for 5 minutes at 4°C and prepare cells for antibody staining.
Transfer yolk sac or AGM tissue into 1.5 mL tubes containing pre-warmed digestion medium.
Add 300 μL of Collagenase Type I-A (1 mg/mL) and 1.2 μL DNase I to the tubes.
Dissect tissues with 25G needles.
Digest tissues at 37°C for 15–20 minutes.
Centrifuge digested samples at 310 g for 5 minutes at 4°C and discard supernatant.
Prepare antibody dilution in 2% FBS/DMEM according to the operating instructions.
Stain cells with a mixture of antibodies (anti-CD44-PE, anti-CD45-APC-eFluor-780, anti-Ter119-PE-Cyanine 5, and anti-CD31-PE-Cyanine 7) for surface antigens.
Incubate cells with the antibody mix at 4°C in the dark for 30 minutes.
Centrifuge tubes containing stained cells at 310 g for 5 minutes at 4°C and discard supernatant.
Resuspend cells in appropriate volume of DPBS.
Incubate cells with 5 μL 7-AAD (in 100 μL DPBS) for 10 min at 4°C, protected from light.
Centrifuge tubes at 310 g for 5 min at 4°C.
Carefully discard the supernatant.
Resuspend cells in appropriate volume of 2% FBS/DMEM.
Co-culture HE cells with OP9-DL1 cells for 1.5–2 h, depending on number of samples and cells.
Gate live cells as 7-AAD-negative cells.
Sort HE cells (GFP+CD44+CD31+CD45-Ter119-) from EGFP+ placentas using a flow cytometer.
Eliminate RBC by gating Ter119-negative cells.
Eliminate maternal cell contamination by gating GFP-positive cells.
Eliminate hematopoietic CD45+ cells.
Gate HE cells as GFP+CD44+CD31+CD45-Ter119- cells.
Change OP9-DL1 culture medium to co-culture medium (500 μL/well) consisting of MEM α, 10% FBS, 1% PS, 1% LG and cytokines at 100 ng/mL each of SCF, Flt3L, and IL3.
Sort 100 HE cells into a pre-prepared 24-well plate containing OP9-DL1 stromal cells cultured for 1 day.
Culture the 24-well plate in an incubator at 37°C with 5% CO2.
Renew half of the co-culture medium (250 μL) daily.
Collect HE cells co-cultured with OP9-DL1 stromal cells after 5 days for further analysis.
Remove only the top layer of co-culture medium to avoid loss of HE or hematopoietic cells during medium renewal.
Gently blow and collect all co-culture medium into 1.5 mL tubes.
Centrifuge tubes at 310g for 5 minutes at 4°C.
Gently blow each well with a pipette gun to dislodge hematopoietic cells.
Filter the cells using single-use cell strainers to create a single-cell suspension.
Incubate surface antibody (anti-CD45-APC-eFluor-780) for 30 minutes at 4°C, protected from light.
Centrifuge tubes at 310 g for 5 minutes at 4°C and carefully discard the supernatant.
Resuspend cells in an appropriate volume of DPBS.
Incubate with 7-AAD, protected from light.
Centrifuge tubes at 310 g for 5 minutes at 4°C and carefully discard the supernatant.
Resuspend cells in an appropriate volume of 2% FBS/DMEM.
Harvest CD45+ hematopoietic cells by FACS, gating on live cells as 7-AAD-negative cells.
Add 1000 collected cells into MethoCult GF M3434 medium (500 μL) in ultra-low attachment 24-well plates for CFU-C assay.
Selectively add PS (5 μL) to the medium to avoid contamination.
Mix cells and medium using a 1.0 mL injection syringe without a needle.
Culture at 37°C in 5% CO2 for 7–15 days.
Distinguish colonies, including CFU-granulocyte-monocyte (CFU-GM) and CFU-granulocyte, erythroid, macrophage, and megakaryocyte (CFU-GEMM), based on morphology.
Count colonies with an inverted microscope.
